title: A Custom range uses the date-picker and holds a 366-day maximum span
refs: SV-8620 (SBR spec v22 2026-08-17 Story 2 S2-R3; S2-R6)
preconds: 1. You are on the Sales By Representative report..
steps:
1. Open the date range picker and select a start and end date within 366 days on the calendar shown inside it; apply.
2. Open it again and try to select a start-to-end span of more than 366 days (start and end dates inclusive).
expected:
1. A custom range within the cap applies normally via the date-picker dialog.
2. A custom selection whose span exceeds 366 days is not accepted — the picker holds you to a range of 366 days or fewer.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Sales By Representative report specification version 24 (S2-R3, S2-R6), read on 17 August 2026.
